lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: This story only addressed the review round 1 WARNING at patterns.md:346 (stale bullet still prescribing the deleted end-anchored greedy-.* regex as the correct oracle-mark extraction pattern). The old bullet is now prefixed `[resolved 2026-07]` and left in place for history; a new bullet directly below it documents the depth-scan approach that actually ships in extractLastOracleRaw (behavioral-gate.ts): locate the LAST `[oracle:` opener via lastIndexOf, scan forward tracking bracket depth, close at the balanced `]`, unterminated -> malformed. This is a docs-only fix; behavioral-gate.ts itself was not touched (it already had the correct implementation from US-001/US-002/US-003). Review round 1 also recorded 4 non-blocking SUGGESTIONs (stale doc comments at behavioral-gate.ts:59/236 re: malformed vs no-oracle wording, a documented-but-untested edge case at extractLastOracleRaw re: unmatched-bracket payload truncation, and agent-doc contracts not yet enumerating the 'malformed' kind) -- none were in scope for this fix-story (only the single WARNING was); they remain in prd.json's review.findings for the reviewer/orchestrator to triage.
